parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, targeting, facility ban, or documented border/document exposure; same-sex activity and gender-identity discrimination are long decriminalised/prohibited, with equality protection extending to goods/services. High public visibility and Pride indicate documented social acceptance, not merely tolerance. Resident-only LGR, care restrictions and marriage law are climate signals only and were not credited as traveller protections. Negative evidence is limited: raw police hate-crime suspicions rose (72 to 241 in the SOGIE category; 1,808 total, no denominator, no hate-crime offence in code), and 2018/2019 violence data are dated and LGBT-wide, not trans-specific prevalence. Border, facilities and custody are undocumented open questions, which weigh lightly against no known exposure in a well-documented state. This places it below 0.85 cases with documented working traveller remedies, but well above friction-only cases.
